notice: Illustrative record for documentation. It was not produced by the Bridlewise engine, is not a live model run, and demonstrates no production readiness. The real engine reports harnessReady: false.

gate.note: This panel is illustrative. The demo is not connected to the Bridlewise engine.

beats.label: Intent
beats.title: Trace the request boundary
beats.summary: Locate the telemetry ingress seam, pin the missing auth gate with one test, and do not commit.
beats.narrative: The operator opens a narrow trace-and-pin task. The only intended file effect is one regression test.
beats.gateNote: Beat 01 · operator intent admitted. No capability invoked.

detail.quote: Trace the request boundary around telemetry ingest. Add one regression check that proves whether the auth gate is missing. Keep the change local; do not commit.

beats.label: Model turn
beats.title: Plan the read and the pin
beats.summary: A synthetic model proposes read, pin, check. No provider request leaves the page.
beats.narrative: The model names the route seam and the exact check. The turn is authored by the demo, not by a running provider.

evidence.label: Synthetic model turn
evidence.detail: Plan accepted · 3 steps · no provider I/O

beats.gateNote: Beat 02 · synthetic model invocation admitted against the offscreen adapter.

plan.title: Read the seam
plan.detail: Inspect the telemetry mount order and the session gate.

plan.title: Pin the hole
plan.detail: Create one focused regression test; make no source edits.

plan.title: Run it alone
plan.detail: Record the failure as evidence, then stop.

beats.label: Tool call
beats.title: Search the route seam
beats.summary: Read-only search finds the route seam and one credential-shaped fixture value.
beats.narrative: The search returns the ingest handler, its mount point, and a fixture line that looks like a credential. The fixture value is masked before this record renders it.

redactions.explanation: A credential-shaped value in the synthetic fixture was masked before this record rendered it. It was never a real secret and never reached a model.

beats.gateNote: Beat 03 · read-only repository access. No model call, process, or egress.

beats.label: File effect
beats.title: Pin the missing gate with one test
beats.summary: Creates one test file. Source stays untouched; nothing is committed.
beats.narrative: This is the only file effect in the run: a new test under the synthetic workspace. The source route remains unchanged.
beats.gateNote: Beat 04 · workspace write admitted. Release actions remain operator-only.

beats.label: Check
beats.title: The targeted check fails
beats.summary: The targeted check exits 1: expected 401, received 200.
beats.narrative: The check is meant to fail until the gate exists. It confirms the missing boundary; it does not prove a fix.
beats.gateNote: Beat 05 · sandboxed check admitted. No network egress was attempted.

transcript.text: [ RUN  ] telemetry ingest refuses an unauthenticated request

beats.label: Finding
beats.title: Telemetry ingress bypasses the auth gate
beats.summary: The route accepts unauthenticated ingest. The failed test and mount order are the proof.
beats.narrative: The failed check is recorded as a high-severity finding. It is a fact with evidence, not a guessed vulnerability.
beats.gateNote: Beat 06 · finding is advisory. No remediation was auto-dispatched.

finding.claim: The telemetry router is mounted before the session gate, so an unauthenticated payload receives a 200.
finding.remedy: Mount the telemetry router behind requireSession, then re-run the check. The fix is not applied in this run.

beats.label: Governance refusal
beats.title: Commit refused at the release gate
beats.summary: git_commit is refused by the release gate. The workspace remains uncommitted.
beats.narrative: The model asks to commit the test as a checkpoint. git_commit is a release action, not a workspace write. Governance returns a typed refusal and no retry path.
beats.gateNote: Beat 07 · release action denied. Workspace write admitted; commit stayed closed.

refusal.remedy: Review the diff and commit outside the run. Do not retry the tool call; ask the operator to release it.

beats.label: Release / decision
beats.title: Hold for operator review
beats.summary: The record closes in a held state. No merge, commit, or egress occurred.
beats.narrative: The record seals with a failing check, an open finding, and a refused commit. Release belongs to the operator.
beats.gateNote: Beat 08 · operator handoff. No release action executed.

decision.reason: A high-severity auth finding is open and the commit was refused.
decision.nextAction: Review the diff, mount telemetry behind the session gate, re-run the check, then decide on release.
